methods_quotes.q: Case-finding activities included review of medical records for patients who visited clinic A, review of state hepatitis surveillance records and crossmatching with clinic A records
In the outbreak investigation setting, case definitions are based on laboratory profile and clinical evidence rather than CDC surveillance case definitions
